Use unchanged frozen-v8 build-engine.sh and archived-v8 selector copies; do not weaken live m0.9 unknown-feature guard or invent observedOFF fields
Single-project source-only rehearsal and support-map proof passed; project is restored to baseline, no CMake configure/build yet

Add exact private Number.isInteger/isFinite mutation differential in a separate restored pure-JS check; ordinary application hooks differ explicitly
Final component imports[] and one run string export; verify all native source/recipe/library/engine/bundle hashes before and after
No genuine OOM/fault/DEBUG, shared/detached hazard or raw/private-memory probe

phases.name: package minimal benchmark pair without measuring
requirements: Reuse exact frozen matched/workload.mjs and benchmark.wit; both arms import their actual installed method
Hold source/world/cases/Node22/toolchain/standard adapter constant; per-arm engine differs only reviewed pair inputs
45 common correctness cases per fresh instance plus3 full-zero/no-pool sizes, two fresh Jco instances and15 fresh Wasmtime cases per arm
Record exact minimal artifact sizes and snapshot variation; no profile-free engine-saving claim
Keep v8/Jco measurement immutable and separate; do not transfer or scale its timings into the new pair

phases.name: coordinated private baseline-candidate timing after correctness
requirements: Fifteen scenarios: call/new/safe/U8/reuse at64B/4KiB/512KiB, same bounded iterations and checksums
Two arm orders, fresh host process per arm/scenario/order; n2 independent processes and seven correlated retained samples per process
Host timer around batch WIT call only; checksum assertion after timing; public processRSS/maxRSS and Memory.buffer.byteLength boundary observations only
Record first batch/compile+binding/instantiation separately, all raw stdout/stderr, process medians/order reversals and all counterexamples
No raw memory reads, private ABI or fabricated in-Wasm grow counts/failures; no guest clocks/custom host service
Attribute only whole return-expression change; no assertion that fill alone caused old slowdown
Any new current-Jco comparison requires a separate matched current-engine adapter arm/window; no numerical comparison to old v8 runs

requirements: Common rebase of accepted concurrent m0.9 changes in both arms, fresh receipts and repeated gates before source promotion
